hypothesis: A four-cent fall from the observed five-minute midpoint may revert enough to cover costs plus two cents; exploratory, unvalidated.
selection: Open binary markets discovered prospectively with explicit rules, supported fees, close within seven-day run. Category rotation plus dedicated MLB/NFL discovery.
controls: Scheduled entries on same sampled universe; not a matched randomized portfolio. Separate 300/900 horizons.
risk: One contract per trial; at most 12 combined staged/open trials, at most one event per arm concurrently, no new entries after arm realized loss reaches $10. Existing versions unchanged.
review: Review zero entries every 30 minutes with blockers; review all losses after each cycle. At 20 closed trials spanning at least 5 events evaluate category/arm costs and loss; register a single prospective replacement hypothesis only after review. Never tune historical returns into success.
